description: Java class implementing a Cucumber hook that performs environment health checks before test scenarios run, avoiding execution if the environment is not suitable.

classes.name: HealthCheckHook.EnvironmentNotReadyException
classes.description: Custom RuntimeException used to indicate that the environment is not ready for test execution.

methods.name: checkEnvironmentHealth
methods.description: Cucumber @Before hook that executes before each scenario to verify environment health and skip scenarios if environment is not ready.

methods.name: getOrComputeClassification
methods.description: Lazily retrieves and caches the environment classification result, performing classification only once.

methods.name: buildFailFastMessage
methods.description: Constructs a detailed message explaining why test execution was skipped based on environment status.

methods.name: getSkippedScenarioCount
methods.description: Returns the count of scenarios skipped due to environment issues.

methods.name: getCachedResult
methods.description: Returns the cached environment classification result, or null if not yet computed.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Resets the cached environment classification and skipped scenario count; useful between test runs.
